source.corrected: Before Undertale’s English release, Toby told me that he intended to release the game in Japanese sometime. He faced some big questions, though. How do you get a game translated and localized? And how do you ensure the final product is good if you don’t even know the language yourself?

translation.zh_hans: 在 Undertale 英文版发售之前，Toby 告诉我，他打算日后推出日文版。不过，他面临着几个大问题：该怎样找人翻译并完成游戏的本地化？如果自己连那门语言都不懂，又该如何确保最终成品的质量？
